name: semver
description: Semantic Versioning (SemVer 2.0.0) validator, parser, comparator, and range matcher. Parses version strings into { major, minor, patch, prerelease, build } components, compares versions correctly, checks compatibility ranges (^, ~, >=, <, =, ||, -), and sorts version arrays.
aiPromptContext: Use this block for dependency version management, CLI tool version checks, automated release pipelines, or any logic requiring semantic version comparison and range matching.
